name: CoW Swap
rootCause: Blockchain security firm Blockaid reported that its system has detected a front-end attack on the decentralized exchange CoW Swap, and that cow.fi has been flagged as a malicious site. Blockaid warned that users who have previously connected their wallets to CoW Swap should immediately revoke any related contract approvals via their wallets or security tools, and refrain from interacting with cow.fi until the issue is resolved to prevent potential asset loss. Subsequently, CoW DAO issued a statement confirming that the CoW Swap front end (swap.cow.fi) is currently experiencing issues. The team is actively investigating and advised users to temporarily avoid using the platform for trading.…

descriptions.text: Blockchain security firm Blockaid reported that its system has detected a front-end attack on the decentralized exchange CoW Swap, and that cow.fi has been flagged as a malicious site. Blockaid warned that users who have previously connected their wallets to CoW Swap should immediately revoke any related contract approvals via their wallets or security tools, and refrain from interacting with cow.fi until the issue is resolved to prevent potential asset loss. Subsequently, CoW DAO issued a statement confirming that the CoW Swap front end (swap.cow.fi) is currently experiencing issues. The team is actively investigating and advised users to temporarily avoid using the platform for trading.…

CoW Swap's frontend was compromised by a DNS hijack on April 14, 2026, allowing attackers to redirect users to a phishing site and steal an estimated $1.2 million. The protocol's smart contracts remained unaffected, but users' wallet approvals were exploited through deceptive interface prompts. Attackers used forged identity documents and social engineering to gain registrar-level control of the cow.fi domain, redirecting CoW Swap users to a pixel-perfect malicious frontend. This enabled wallet drainer scripts to extract assets by convincing users to sign broad approvals.
